Riding style: All-mountain freestyle — aggressive all-mountain-freestyle [70] 120. Use case: "Quiver-of-one" for advanced riders who ride park, groomers, and powder [71] 121. Edge hold: Good edge hold once on an edge, grips well with a strong and reliable feel through the whole turn [76] 127. Speed capability: Fast board with a fast sintered base [77] 128. Carving: Fun to carve, springs out of turns nicely [78] 129. Powder performance: OK in powder, not epic but decent for this category — directional twin with rocker helps [79] 130. Switch riding: Rides well switch due to near-twin shape [80] 131. Responsiveness: Highly responsive flex balanced with a smooth ride [81] 132. Chatter (pre-2025): Pre-2025 models had severe chatter in uneven/variable snow conditions — "would send chatter into my joints and make them hurt like no other snowboard" [82] 133. Chatter (post-2025): Addition of recycled ABS sidewalls significantly improved dampening — "much more acceptable" but "not super damp now" [43] 134. Dampening vs. standard Assassin: The Assassin Pro is less damp than the regular Assassin due to lighter construction [83] 135. Conditions sensitivity: "The minute conditions change, it becomes very hard to ride" (pre-2025 assessment) [84] 136. Review criticism: "It does everything pretty well, but doesn't stand out in any one way" — described as "a bit boring" [85] 137. Topsheet cracking (Salomon boards generally): Forum reports of cosmetic topsheet cracking on some Salomon boards near binding edges, though described as "entirely cosmetic" [86] 138. Ice performance (with Freestyle EB tune): Some riders found the Freestyle EB edge bevel makes boards struggle on ice, requiring re-tuning [87] 139. Gearscore review (2019 model): 19.0/20 — top-rated all-mountain board alongside Nitro Team and Burton Custom X [88] 140. Looria aggregated rating (Assassin Pro): B rating from 48 reviews [89] 141. Competitor: Capita Defenders of Awesome (DOA) — comparable all-mountain freestyle; poppier and more lively per some riders [92] 146. Competitor: Capita Super DOA — similar profile and flex with lighter weight but higher price [93] 147.
